visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a street view of a shop named 'EL GATO NEGRO' in yellow lettering on a black sign. Several people, including a man in a red shirt and sunglasses, are visible near stone arches in the background under bright daylight. (2) Inside the shop, the camera focuses on a display wall with a yellow grid holding knitted samples like a purple cape and green top, along with colorful yarn swatches. A person's hand with a ring and white watch band touches the swatches. (3) The camera moves to wooden shelves packed with colorful yarn balls. Detailed labels with prices like '6€' and QR codes are attached to some bundles. The setting is indoors with warm, bright lighting that highlights the textures of the yarn. (4) A large informational poster titled 'TEJIENDO EL OTOÑO' is shown, featuring a QR code and fall-themed illustrations. Below it, a wooden shelf holds rows of vibrant yarn in autumn colors like yellow, orange, and blue. (5) The camera pans across another shelf dedicated to knitting needles of various materials and sizes, neatly arranged in yellow slots. A brown sign above them provides store policy in Spanish. (6) A digital scale hangs from the ceiling in front of more shelves filled with yarn. The display shows green numbers against a dark background. The environment is a traditional retail store with high-density inventory. (7) Close-up shots show the hand interacting with different types of yarn, including multi-colored variegated balls. Finally, three balls of yarn—one multi-colored and two solid purple—are shown on a black surface atop a yellow wooden table.
